The issue description and comment read:

> Summary: Improve error logging for timeouts in the HTTP client so that users can distinguish between DNS failures, connection timeouts, and read timeouts without increasing log verbosity elsewhere.
>
> Steps:
> 1. Reproduce the current behavior by running the existing tests for the HTTP client:
>    - From the repository root, run: `pytest tests/http_client/ -k "timeout"`.
>    - Confirm the current log output for the timeout-related tests and capture an example in your notes.
> 2. In `http_client/client.py`, locate the timeout handling logic in `HttpClient.request`.
>    - Do not change the method signature or public API.
>    - Follow the existing logging style and conventions described in the Project Contribution Guide.
> 3. Adjust the logging so that:
>    - Timeout errors include a short, structured reason string (e.g., `reason="dns" | "connect" | "read"`).
>    - The log level and logger name remain consistent with the existing timeout logging.
>    - No new external dependencies are introduced.
> 4. Add or update tests under `tests/http_client/test_timeouts.py` to:
>    - Assert that the appropriate reason string appears in log records for DNS, connect, and read timeouts.
>    - Use the existing test patterns for capturing and asserting on logs.
> 5. Run the full HTTP client test subset locally:
>    - `pytest tests/http_client/`.
>    - Fix any failures introduced by your changes.
> 6. Once tests pass, open a pull request with:
>    - A concise title: "Improve timeout error logging in HTTP client".
>    - A description summarizing the behavior change, referencing this issue, and listing the new tests.
>    - No documentation changes are required unless the Contribution Guide indicates that logging behavior changes must be documented; if so, update the relevant doc section accordingly.
>
> Please follow the Project Contribution Guide closely (logging conventions, tests, and PR format). If any of the steps are unclear, ask for clarification before proceeding.
